        time_fraction_random_variability=0, pref_index=0, wd_we_type=2)

    app.specific_cycle(2, p_21=276, t_21=1, p_22=2.0, t_22=53, r_c2=0, cw21=[570, 735], cw22=[855, 1230])
    app.specific_cycle(3, p_31=276, t_31=3, p_32=2.0, t_32=42, r_c3=0, cw31=[0, 420], cw32=[1230, 1440])

    uc = UseCase(name="pue", date_start="2024-01-01", date_end="2025-04-25")

    declarer(user)
